usageNotes: Use this to enumerate all LXC containers on a specific node, including their running status, resource usage, and configuration metadata. Results are scoped to the caller's VM.Audit permissions — containers the caller cannot audit are silently omitted, so an empty list does not mean no containers exist. The target node must be online; requests to an offline or unreachable node will return an error.

examples.summary: List all LXC containers on node 'pve1'

tips: Entries with 'template': true are container templates, not running guests — filter these out when looking for active workloads.
The 'lock' field (e.g., 'backup', 'migrate', 'snapshot') indicates the container is mid-operation; avoid config changes or power actions until the lock clears.
CPU, mem, disk I/O, and network counters are only populated for running containers; stopped containers will have those fields absent or zero.
Pressure fields (pressurecpusome, pressureiosome, etc.) reflect Linux PSI metrics and are only available on nodes running a kernel with PSI support enabled.
